integrity: The general result is proved by exact current-kernel identities and a cited established graph-classification theorem; finite rational calculations provide independent consistency checks, not an infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform spanning-tree measure only; neither general degree-weighted negative association nor full Rayleigh stability is asserted. Existing distance-hereditary stability theorem is credited; implicit earlier covariance specialization remains a priority risk.
title: Pairwise degree repulsion without real stability in wheel spanning trees
